English: Courage and perseverance have a magical talisman, before which difficulties disappear and obstacles vanish into air.
Chinese: 勇气和毅力拥有神奇的力量，在它们面前，困难和阻碍会消失得无影无踪。
Author: John Quincy Adams

English: Rise above the storm and you will find the sunshine.
Chinese: 穿越过风暴，你就会看见阳光。
Author: Mario Fernández

English: One has to be positive. When you're positive, good things happen.
Chinese: 你要乐观，你一乐观，好事就会发生。
Author: Deep Roy

English: Difficult times often bring out the best in people.
Chinese: 困境通常能激发出人最好的一面。
Author: Bernie Sanders

English: Love makes your soul crawl out from its hiding place.
Chinese: 爱，让你的灵魂不再躲藏。
Author: Zora Neale Hurston

English: No matter what you're going through, there's a light at the end of the tunnel.
Chinese: 无论你正在经历什么，隧道尽头总会有光。
Author: Demi Lovato

English: Let perseverance be your engine and hope your fuel.
Chinese: 让坚毅成为你的发动机，让希望成为你的燃料。
Author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.

English: Once you've been through tough times, you can only become stronger.
Chinese: 你熬过的艰难时期，只会让你更加强大。
Author: Alesha Dixon

English: Even if happiness forgets you a little bit, never completely forget about it.
Chinese: 幸福会忘掉你一阵子，但你可不要完全忘记它。
Author: Jacques Prévert

English: Never lose hope. Storms make people stronger and never last forever.
Chinese: 永远怀抱希望。暴风雨会让人更加坚强，而且不会恒久长存。
Author: Roy T. Bennett

English: It's faith that will take you through, and determination that will drive you.
Chinese: 信念带你渡过难关，决心为你加油鼓劲。
Author: Jonathan Anthony Burkett

English: Most of us have far more courage than we ever dreamed we possessed.
Chinese: 我们中的大多数人拥有着超乎自己想象的勇气。
Author: Dale Carnegie

English: Give whatever you are doing and whoever you are with the gift of your attention.
Chinese: 无论在做什么，跟谁相处，都要送出这份礼物：保持专注。
Author: Jim Rohn

English: Heard melodies are sweet, but those unheard are sweeter.
Chinese: 听见的旋律是美妙的，但听不见的会更美。
Author: John Keats

English: The greatest pleasure I know is to do a good action by stealth, and to have it found out by accident.
Chinese: 我所知的最大乐趣是，暗中行善举，但又偶然间为人所知。
Author: Charles Lamb

English: Your vision will become clear only when you can look into your own heart.
Chinese: 唯有审视内心，你的愿景才会清晰起来。
Author: Carl Jung

English: Be steady and well-ordered in your life so that you can be fierce and original in your work.
Chinese: 生活中沉稳可靠、井井有条，方能在工作中脱颖而出、不同凡响。
Author: Gustave Flaubert

English: We first make our habits, then our habits make us.
Chinese: 我们养成习惯，接着习惯成就我们。
Author: John Dryden

English: Every individual has a place to fill in the world.
Chinese: 每一个来到这个世界上的人，都有一个属于他自己的位置。
Author: Nathaniel Hawthorne

English: If the moon smiled, she would resemble you.
Chinese: 月亮要是笑起来，她就会和你一样。
Author: Sylvia Plath

English: The landscape belongs to the person who looks at it.
Chinese: 风景属于那些看风景的人。
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

English: What lies behind you and what lies in front of you, pales in comparison to what lies inside of you.
Chinese: 无论是你的过去，还是将来，与你的内在相比，都微不足道。
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

English: The desire to reach for the stars is ambitious. The desire to reach hearts is wise and most possible.
Chinese: 想要触摸天上星辰，志存高远；想要触碰心灵，明智且最可行。
Author: Maya Angelou

English: Half of the troubles of this life can be traced to saying yes too quickly and not saying no soon enough.
Chinese: 生活中有半数烦恼，来自于答应得太快和拒绝得太慢。
Author: Josh Billings

English: It is not worth the while to let our imperfections disturb us always.
Chinese: 犯不着总是为自己的不完美而烦恼。
Author: Henry David Thoreau

English: There is a pleasure in the pathless woods; there is a rapture on the lonely shore.
Chinese: 无径之林，常有乐趣；无人之岸，几多欢喜。
Author: Lord Byron

English: Whoever is careless with the truth in small matters cannot be trusted with important matters.
Chinese: 凡在小事上对真理持轻率态度的人，在大事上就不能被委以信任。
Author: Albert Einstein

English: The most alluring thing a woman can have is confidence.
Chinese: 女性的最迷人之处，就是拥有自信。
Author: Beyoncé Giselle Knowles-Carter

English: If you love somebody, let them go, for if they return, they were always yours. If they don't, they never were.
Chinese: 爱一个人，就要放手；若能回来，便永远属于你；若没回来，便从未属于过你。
Author: Kahlil Gibran

English: Blessed are the hearts that can bend; they shall never be broken.
Chinese: 能够弯曲的心灵是幸运的，因为它永远不会破碎。
Author: Albert Camus

English: The golden rule is that there are no golden rules.
Chinese: 真正的金科玉律就是世上并无金科玉律。
Author: George Bernard Shaw

English: He who plants a tree, plants a hope.
Chinese: 种下一棵树，就是种下一个希望。
Author: Lucy Larcom

English: Personality is to a man what perfume is to a flower.
Chinese: 个性之于人正如芳香之于花。
Author: Charles M. Schwab

English: The world needs dreamers and the world needs doers. But above all, the world needs dreamers who do.
Chinese: 世界需要梦想家，也需要实践者，但这世界最需要的是能实践的梦想家。
Author: Sarah Ban Breathnach

English: Things turn out best for the people who make the best of the way things turn out.
Chinese: 充分利用既有结果的人，就会获得最佳结果。
Author: John Wooden

English: Keep your best wishes close to your heart and watch what happens.
Chinese: 心怀最美好的愿望，再看看会发生什么。
Author: Tony DeLiso

English: If you saturate your mind with positive thoughts, it will sustain you in any situation.
Chinese: 让大脑装满积极的想法，能支撑你度过任何境遇。
Author: Lailah Gifty Akita

English: When everything seems to be going against you, remember that the airplane takes off against the wind, not with it.
Chinese: 当你感到似乎事事不顺时，记住，飞机都是逆风起飞的，不是顺风。
Author: Henry Ford

English: People may hear your words, but they feel your attitude.
Chinese: 你的话，别人能听到，但你的态度才是别人能感受到的。
Author: John C. Maxwell

English: Despite the forecast, live like it's spring.
Chinese: 无论天气预报怎样，把每天都当成春天来过。
Author: Lilly Pulitzer

English: Opportunities are like sunrises. If you wait too long, you miss them.
Chinese: 机会如同日出，等得太久就会错过。
Author: William Arthur Ward

English: Take chances; make mistakes. That's how you grow.
Chinese: 去冒险，去犯错。你就是这样成长起来的。
Author: Mary Tyler Moore

English: They always say time changes things, but you actually have to change them yourself.
Chinese: 人们总说时间会改变一切，但改变还是要靠你自己。
Author: Andy Warhol

English: Happiness, it comes on unexpectedly. And goes beyond, really, any early morning talk about it.
Chinese: 幸福，在不经意间降临，它着实胜过每个谈论幸福的清晨。
Author: Raymond Carver

English: One loves the sunset when one is so sad.
Chinese: 当一个人情绪低落的时候，他会格外喜欢看日落。
Author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

English: You can't cross the sea merely by standing and staring at the water.
Chinese: 光站在那里盯着海面，是没法穿越海洋的。
Author: 泰戈尔

English: Do something wonderful; people may imitate it.
Chinese: 去做美好的事，人们可能会效仿。
Author: Albert Schweitzer

English: All human wisdom is summed up in these two words: wait and hope.
Chinese: 人类所有的智慧可以归结为两个词：等待和希望。
Author: Alexandre Dumas

English: You're only here for a short visit. Don't hurry; don't worry. And be sure to smell the flowers along the way.
Chinese: 你只是到这作短暂停留而已，不要匆忙，不要忧愁，务必要去感受下沿途的花香。
Author: Walter Hagen

English: Time moves in one direction, memory in another.
Chinese: 时间向前流逝，而回忆却向后延展。
Author: William Gibson

English: Lose an hour in the morning, and you will spend all day looking for it.
Chinese: 早上浪费一小时，得用一天的时间来弥补。
Author: Richard Whately

English: If life is a joke, let us play it.
Chinese: 假如生活是一则玩笑，不妨游乐其中。
Author: Santosh Kalwar

English: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you've imagined.
Chinese: 自信地往梦想的方向前进吧；去过你所设想的生活。
Author: Henry David Thoreau

English: Experience is what you get when you didn't get what you wanted.
Chinese: 得不到想得到的东西时，你就会得到经验。
Author: Randy Pausch

English: A hero is no braver than an ordinary man, but he is braver five minutes longer.
Chinese: 英雄不比普通人勇敢多少，但他们会比普通人多勇敢五分钟。
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

English: To live in hearts we leave behind is not to die.
Chinese: 活在生者心里，便永远不会逝去。
Author: Thomas Campbell

English: It has been my observation that most people get ahead during the time that others waste.
Chinese: 据我观察，大多数人都是在他人浪费光阴时，实现赶超领先的。
Author: Henry Ford

English: You cannot explore the universe if you think that you are the center of it.
Chinese: 若把自己当作宇宙的中心，就无法对宇宙进行探索。
Author: Joshua Suya Pelicano

English: Whatever you do in life, remember: think higher and feel deeper. It cannot be bad if you do that.
Chinese: 生活中不管做什么事，记住：思考角度要更高，感知要更深刻。这样做是绝对不会有坏处的。
Author: Elie Wiesel

English: You were born with wings. Why prefer to crawl through life?
Chinese: 你生而有翼，为何竟愿一生匍匐前行？
Author: Rumi

English: Kindness is always fashionable, and always welcome.
Chinese: 善良，永不过时，也永远为人所喜闻乐见。
Author: Amelia Barr

English: Respect yourself enough to walk away from anything that no longer serves you, grows you, or makes you happy.
Chinese: 尊重自己，远离那些不再对你有用、不再让你成长或快乐的事。
Author: Robert Tew

English: For beautiful eyes, look for the good in others; for beautiful lips, speak only words of kindness.
Chinese: 若想拥有美丽的双眸，请寻找他人的优点；若想拥有漂亮的双唇，请出言善良。
Author: Audrey Hepburn

English: Putting off an easy thing makes it hard, and putting off a hard one makes it impossible.
Chinese: 简单的事，越拖越难，困难的事，越拖越不可能做。
Author: George Horace Lorimer

English: Wisdom is oftentimes nearer when we stoop than when we soar.
Chinese: 比起高飞的时候，智慧往往在我们俯身时更接近我们。
Author: William Wordsworth

English: If you don't value your time, neither will others.
Chinese: 如果你不珍惜自己的时间，别人也不会珍惜。
Author: Kim Garst

English: Real strength is not just a condition of one's muscle, but a tenderness in one's spirit.
Chinese: 真正的力量并不只在于肌肉强弱，还关乎一个人心中的柔情。
Author: McCallister Dodds

English: I was always looking outside myself for strength and confidence, but it comes from within. It is there all the time.
Chinese: 我曾总是向自我之外寻找力量与自信，但其实它来自于我自身，始终如此。
Author: Anna Freud

English: I know for sure that what we dwell on is who we become.
Chinese: 我确信，盘踞在我们脑中的思绪，决定了我们会成为怎样的人。
Author: 奥普拉·温弗里

English: The whole point in being a hero is to do something greater than yourself.
Chinese: 做一名英雄，关键在于，要做出超越你自身的伟大之举。
Author: 《真爱如血》

English: Spring is the time of plans and projects.
Chinese: 春日适于开启计划与安排。
Author: 列夫·托尔斯泰

English: Love is the triumph of imagination over intelligence.
Chinese: 爱情，是想象对理智的胜利。
Author: H. L. Mencken

English: Life's hard. It's supposed to be. If we didn't suffer, we wouldn't learn a thing.
Chinese: 生活本就该是艰辛的。如果不受苦，我们就学不到任何东西。
Author: 《爱在日落黄昏时》

English: I think it’s the books that you read when you’re young that live with you forever.
Chinese: 我想，你年轻时读过的书，才会陪伴你一生一世。
Author: J·K·罗琳

English: Yesterday is but today's memory, tomorrow is today's dream.
Chinese: 昨日不过今日的回忆，明天却是今天的梦想。
Author: 纪伯伦

English: We can love completely without complete understanding.
Chinese: 我们可以全心全意去爱我们并不全然理解的人。
Author: 《大河恋》

English: Nothing is too small to know, and nothing is too big to attempt.
Chinese: 没有事情会小到不值得了解，也没有什么事情会大到无法尝试。
Author: William Van Horne

English: Dost thou love life? Then do not squander time, for that's the stuff life is made of.
Chinese: 你热爱生命吗？那就别浪费时间，因为生命是由时间构成的。
Author: 本杰明·富兰克林

English: Don't cry when the sun is gone, because the tears won't let you see the stars.
Chinese: 不要在太阳落下时哭泣，因为泪水会让你错过星星。
Author: Violeta Parra

English: It will never rain roses: when we want to have more roses we must plant more trees.
Chinese: 玫瑰不会从天而降，如果想要更多的玫瑰，必须自己去种。
Author: George Eliot

English: Love yourself first and everything else falls into line.
Chinese: 要先爱你自己，这样其他的一切才会步入正轨。
Author: Lucille Ball

English: Here's to a vacation of no regrets!
Chinese: 为无悔的假期干杯！
Author: Joan Rylen

English: If you want to succeed, you should strike out on new paths rather than travel the worn paths of accepted success.
Chinese: 如果你想成功，就应该去开辟新路，而不是走大家公认的成功的老路。
Author: John D. Rockefeller

English: Anything looked at closely becomes wonderful.
Chinese: 在近距离的观察下，任何事物都会显得美妙无比。
Author: A. R. Ammons

English: Youth is not a time of life; it is a state of mind.
Chinese: 青春不是年华，而是心境。
Author: Samuel Ullman

English: Happiness is not a station you arrive at, but a manner of traveling.
Chinese: 幸福并不是你所抵达的站点，而是一种旅行的方式。
Author: Margaret Lee Runbeck

English: The farther behind I leave the past, the closer I am to forging my own character.
Chinese: 我把过去抛得越远，便越接近于我自己锻造的自我。
Author: Isabelle Eberhardt

English: Only those who risk going too far can possibly find out how far they can go.
Chinese: 唯有那些敢于冒险大步向前的人，才能够了解自己能走多远。
Author: T. S. Eliot

English: The most wasted of all days is one without laughter.
Chinese: 没有欢笑的一天便最是虚度。
Author: E. E. Cummings

English: The chief proof of man's real greatness lies in his perception of his own smallness.
Chinese: 一个人的真正伟大之处就体现在他能够认识到自己的渺小。
Author: 阿瑟·柯南·道尔

English: I realized when you look at your mother, you are looking at the purest love you will ever know.
Chinese: 我意识到，当你望向你的母亲时，你望着的是此生最纯洁的爱。
Author: Mitch Albom

English: Little by little, one travels far.
Chinese: 跬步之积，也可达千里。
Author: J·R·R·托尔金

English: You have to have confidence in your ability, and then be tough enough to follow through.
Chinese: 你要对自己的能力有信心，然后保持坚强、坚持到底。
Author: Rosalynn Carter

English: Although the world is full of suffering, it is also full of the overcoming of it.
Chinese: 虽然世界处处有苦难，但战胜苦难的例子也比比皆是。
Author: 海伦·凯勒

English: Absence is to love what wind is to fire; it extinguishes the small, it enkindles the great.
Chinese: 离别之于爱，犹如风之于火：能熄灭微弱火苗，也能助长熊熊大火。
Author: Roger de Rabutin

English: Wanting to be someone else is a waste of the person you are.
Chinese: 试图成为另一个人，便是浪费了成为你自己的机会。
Author: Kurt Cobain

English: In order to be irreplaceable one must always be different.
Chinese: 要想变得无可替代，就必须与众不同。
Author: 可可·香奈儿

English: The kind of beauty I want most is the hard-to-get kind that comes from within - strength, courage, dignity.
Chinese: 我最想拥有的美，是那种源自内在的、难得的美——那是力量、勇气、尊严。
Author: Ruby Dee

English: When a thing is done, it's done. Don't look back. Look forward to your next objective.
Chinese: 事情做完了就是做完了。别回头，继续去寻找下一个目标吧！
Author: George C. Marshall

English: The guy who takes a chance, who walks the line between the known and unknown, who is unafraid of failure, will succeed.
Chinese: 敢于冒险的人，游走在已知和未知之间的人，不怕失败的人，才会成功。
Author: Gordon Parks

English: I love you not only for what you are, but for what I am when I am with you.
Chinese: 我爱你，不仅因为你是什么样的人，还因为和你在一起时，我可以变成什么样。
Author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

English: He who would travel happily must travel light.
Chinese: 想要快乐旅行的人必须轻装上阵。
Author: 安托万·德·圣埃克苏佩里

English: We are each responsible for our own life—no other person is or even can be.
Chinese: 自己的生活只能由自己负责，没有别人，也不会有人代劳。
Author: 奥普拉·温弗里

English: What makes you different or weird—that's your strength.
Chinese: 那些让你显得与众不同或不寻常的地方，就是你的长处。
Author: 梅丽尔·斯特里普

English: Happy people build their inner world. Unhappy people blame their outer world.
Chinese: 快乐的人建构内心世界，不快乐的人责怪外在世界。
Author: T. Harv Eker

English: Be alone, that is the secret of invention; be alone, that is when ideas are born.
Chinese: 独处是发明的秘方；独处是创意的摇篮。
Author: 尼古拉·特斯拉

English: I call architecture frozen music.
Chinese: 我称建筑为凝结的音乐。
Author: 歌德

English: Live in the sunshine, swim the sea, drink the wild air.
Chinese: 去生活在阳光下吧，去畅游大海，去畅饮野外的空气。
Author: 拉尔夫·沃尔多·爱默生

English: Knowledge speaks, but wisdom listens.
Chinese: 知识会说话，但智慧是会倾听。
Author: Jimi Hendrix

English: One man with courage makes a majority.
Chinese: 若有勇气，一个人抵得上千军万马。
Author: Andrew Jackson

English: When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.
Chinese: 当一件事情足够重要时，即便缺乏胜算，你也会去做。
Author: 伊隆·马斯克

English: I adore simple pleasures. They are the last refuge of the complex.
Chinese: 我崇尚简单的快乐。它们是繁复世界最后的避难所。
Author: 奥斯卡·王尔德

English: A child is not a vase to be filled, but a fire to be lit.
Chinese: 孩子不是要装满的瓶子，而是等着点着的火焰。
Author: François Rabelais

English: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams! Live the life you've imagined.
Chinese: 自信地朝你的梦想前进吧！去过你想要过的生活。
Author: 亨利·戴维·梭罗

English: Concern for someone else was a good remedy for taking the mind off one's own troubles.
Chinese: 关心别人是解除自身烦恼的良方。
Author: Elizabeth Aston

English: Luck is what you have left over after you give 100 percent.
Chinese: 幸运，就是你付出百分之百后剩下的东西。
Author: Langston Coleman

English: Plans to protect air and water, wilderness and wildlife are in fact plans to protect man.
Chinese: 那些保护空气、水和野生动物的计划，实际上是为了保护人类自己。
Author: Stewart Udall

English: Wherever you go, no matter what the weather, always bring your own sunshine.
Chinese: 无论去哪儿，无论天气怎样，记得带上自己的阳光。
Author: Anthony J. D'Angelo

English: The charm of sunset makes me want to scurry home.
Chinese: 日落的魅力，让我想快步赶回家。
Author: Tara Estacaan

English: We are most alive when we're in love.
Chinese: 沉浸在爱中的生命是最鲜活的。
Author: John Updike

English: I'm gonna take all this negativity and use it as fuel and I'm gonna find a silver lining.
Chinese: 我要把所有的消极影响化作力量，我要找到失望中的一丝希望。
Author: 《乌云背后的幸福线》

English: One doesn't discover new lands without consenting to lose sight of the shore for a very long time.
Chinese: 不愿在看不见海岸线的情况下久久漂流，是不会发现新大陆的。
Author: 安德烈·纪德

English: There is ugliness in this world, disarray. I choose to see the beauty.
Chinese: 这世上确有丑恶与混乱，而我选择看到美好。
Author: 《西部世界》

English: To love is to receive a glimpse of heaven.
Chinese: 去爱，便能一窥天堂。
Author: Karen Sunde

English: You gave me a forever within the numbered days, and I’m grateful.
Chinese: 在有限的日子里，你为我创造出了永恒。我很感激。
Author: 《星运里的错》

English: We have only this moment, sparkling like a star in our hand... and melting like a snowflake.
Chinese: 我们只拥有此刻，星光一般闪过，雪花一般融逝的一瞬间。
Author: Marie Beyon Ray

English: A dream that you don’t fight for can haunt you for the rest of your life.
Chinese: 没有为之奋斗的梦想会纠缠你一辈子。
Author: 《机器人历险记》

English: When I discover who I am, I'll be free.
Chinese: 当我发现自己是谁的时候，我就自由了。
Author: Ralph Ellison

English: The most profound statements are often said in silence.
Chinese: 最深刻的语句，往往是在沉默中说出的。
Author: Lynn Johnston

English: Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
Chinese: 困难能磨练心志，正如劳动能强壮体魄。
Author: Seneca

English: You never find yourself until you face the truth.
Chinese: 面对现实才能认清自我。
Author: Pearl Bailey

English: Never assume that you’re stuck with the way things are. Life changes, and so can you.
Chinese: 永远别认为你无法摆脱现状，人生会改变，你也会。
Author: Ralph Marston

English: Dads are most ordinary men turned by love into heroes, adventurers, story-tellers, and singers of songs.
Chinese: 父亲们不过是群普通人，但爱让他们化身英雄、探险家、故事家和歌者。
Author: Pam Brown

English: The trees that are slow to grow bear the best fruit.
Chinese: 长得很慢的树，能结出最好的果子。
Author: 莫里哀

English: Kites rise highest against the wind, not with it.
Chinese: 风筝逆风才能高飞——而不是顺风。
Author: 温斯顿·丘吉尔

English: If the entire world was one big machine, I couldn't be an extra part. I had to be here for some reason.
Chinese: 如果世界是一个巨大的机器，我就不会是多余的零件。我在这里，总是有原因的。
Author: 《雨果》

English: Health and cheerfulness naturally beget each other.
Chinese: 安康喜乐，相生相成。
Author: Joseph Addison

English: How many a man has dated a new era in his life from the reading of a book.
Chinese: 有多少人因为读了一本书而开启了人生的新篇章呀！
Author: 亨利·戴维·梭罗

English: A flower cannot blossom without sunshine, and man cannot live without love.
Chinese: 花儿没有阳光便不能绽放，人没有爱便不能生存。
Author: Max Müller

English: I'd rather regret the things I've done than regret the things I haven't done.
Chinese: 我宁愿为自己做过的事后悔，也不愿为自己没做的事遗憾。
Author: Lucille Ball

English: I will love the light for it shows me the way, yet I will endure the darkness for it shows me the stars.
Chinese: 我将热爱光明，因为它为我指明道路，而我将忍受黑暗，因为它向我展示繁星。
Author: Og Mandino

English: Your children don't need you to be perfect. They just need you to believe in them.
Chinese: 孩子并不需要你是个完人，只需要你的信任。
Author: 《小飞象》

English: I have found that if you love life, life will love you back.
Chinese: 我发现，如果你爱生活，生活也会用爱来回报你。
Author: Arthur Rubinstein

English: Forgiveness does not change the past, but it does enlarge the future.
Chinese: 宽恕无法改变过去，却能拓宽未来。
Author: Paul Boese

English: We have to do the best we are capable of. This is our sacred human responsibility.
Chinese: 我们必须尽力而为，这是我们生而为人的神圣责任。
Author: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦

English: The worst loneliness is not to be comfortable with yourself.
Chinese: 最糟糕的孤独是无法舒适地和自己相处。
Author: 马克·吐温

English: That's what I consider true generosity. You give your all, and yet you always feel as if it costs you nothing.
Chinese: 我认为，真正的慷慨是奉献所有，却仍觉得没有损失分毫。
Author: 西蒙娜·德·波伏娃

English: Be as simple as you can be. You'll be astonished to see how uncomplicated and happy your life will be.
Chinese: 尽量简单做自己，你就会惊奇地发现，生活是如此简单而且快乐。
Author: 《乔布斯》

English: Today is your opportunity to build the tomorrow you want.
Chinese: 想要创造出明天，今天就是你的机会。
Author: Ken Poirot

English: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
Chinese: 相信自己能成功，你就已经成功了一半。
Author: Theodore Roosevelt

English: Try to be a rainbow in someone's cloud.
Chinese: 试着去成为别人乌云里的一道彩虹吧！
Author: Maya Angelou

English: Change the way you look at things and the things you look at change.
Chinese: 改变你看待事物的方式，你所看到的事物也会改变。
Author: Wayne W. Dyer

English: I have failed many times, and that's why I am a success.
Chinese: 我失败过很多次，这就是我成功的原因。
Author: 迈克尔·乔丹

English: There is an applause superior to that of the multitudes: one's own.
Chinese: 有一种掌声，比大众的掌声更优裕：那就是你自己给自己鼓的掌。
Author: Elizabeth Elton Smith

English: Summer friends will melt away like summer snows, but winter friends are friends forever.
Chinese: 盛夏的朋友会像盛夏的雪一样融化流逝，但数九寒天的朋友会是永远的朋友。
Author: 《权力的游戏》

English: Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
Chinese: 忍耐是痛苦的，但果实是甜蜜的。
Author: 亚里士多德

English: Bear in mind that you should conduct yourself in life as at a feast.
Chinese: 要记住，你在生活中应该表现得像出席宴会一样优雅。
Author: Epictetus

English: We cannot choose the day or time when we will fully bloom. It happens in its own time.
Chinese: 我们无法选择自己盛开的时日。时候到了，它就会发生的。
Author: Denis Waitley

English: A lot of people are afraid to say what they want. That's why they don't get what they want.
Chinese: 很多人想要却不敢开口，这就是为什么他们想要却得不到。
Author: 麦当娜

English: Well-timed silence has more eloquence than speech.
Chinese: 适时的静默比雄辩更有说服力。
Author: Martin Fraquhar Tupper

English: A tiny change today brings a dramatically different tomorrow.
Chinese: 今天的微小改变，会带来全然不同的明天。
Author: Richard Bach

English: Family means no one gets left behind or forgotten.
Chinese: 家意味着没有人会被落下，或被遗忘。
Author: David Ogden Stiers

English: We love life, not because we are used to living but because we are used to loving.
Chinese: 我们热爱生活，并不因为我们习惯了生活，而是因为我们习惯了去热爱。
Author: 弗里德里希·尼采

English: In the midst of winter, I found there was, within me, an invincible summer.
Chinese: 在隆冬，我终于知道，我的内心有一个不可战胜的夏天。
Author: 阿尔贝·加缪

English: Success doesn't come from what you do occasionally. It comes from what you do consistently.
Chinese: 成功并不来自你偶然做了什么，而是你一直在做什么。
Author: Marie Forleo

English: Keep a little fire burning; however small, however hidden.
Chinese: 让心中的火苗一直燃烧吧，不管那有多微弱，不管藏得有多深。
Author: Cormac McCarthy

English: I'm not telling you it is going to be easy, I'm telling you it's going to be worth it.
Chinese: 我不会告诉你这个过程很容易。我只会说，这一切都是值得的。
Author: Art Williams

English: Love is the one thing that transcends time and space.
Chinese: 爱是唯一可以超越时空的东西。
Author: 《星际穿越》

English: No amount of money ever bought a second of time.
Chinese: 再多的钱也无法买回逝去的光阴。
Author: 《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》

English: I celebrate myself, and sing myself.
Chinese: 我为自己欢庆，为自己歌唱。
Author: Walt Whitman

English: Sometimes you gotta get through your fears to see the beauty on the other side.
Chinese: 有时候，你要克服内心的恐惧，才能看见彼端的美景。
Author: 《恐龙当家》

English: You must expect great things of yourself before you can do them.
Chinese: 你必须先见到很棒的自己，才能做出很棒的事。
Author: 迈克尔·乔丹

English: When all else is lost, the future still remains.
Chinese: 即使失去一切，未来仍在。
Author: Christian Nestell Bovee

English: Wisdom is the power to put our time and our knowledge to the proper use.
Chinese: 所谓智慧，就是合理利用好我们的时间和知识。
Author: Thomas J. Watson

English: When we seek to discover the best in others, we somehow bring out the best in ourselves.
Chinese: 当我们努力发掘他人的好时，我们往往也会看到自己最好的一面。
Author: William Arthur Ward

English: Being brave means knowing that when you fail, you don’t fail forever.
Chinese: 勇敢就是知道即使你失败了，你也不是永远失败。
Author: Lana Del Rey

English: We are the hero of our own story.
Chinese: 我们都是我们自己故事里的英雄。
Author: Mary McCarthy

English: Promise yourself to be so strong that nothing can disturb your peace of mind.
Chinese: 对自己承诺：要强大到任何事情都无法破坏你内心的平和。 ​​​​
Author: Christian D. Larson

English: An aim in life is the only fortune worth finding.
Chinese: 生活的目标，是唯一值得我们去寻找的财富。
Author: Robert Louis Stevenson

English: Nobody realizes that some people expend tremendous energy merely to be normal.
Chinese: 没有人意识到，有些人花了大量的精力就只是为了做个平常人。
Author: 阿尔贝·加缪

English: It is not in the stars to hold our destiny but in ourselves.
Chinese: 我们的命运是由自己，而不是天上的星星掌握。
Author: 威廉·莎士比亚

English: The wound is the place where the light enters you.
Chinese: 伤口是光照进你内心的地方。
Author: Rumi

English: Nothing you wear is more important than your smile.
Chinese: 不管如何穿戴，都不比带上你的微笑。
Author: Connie Stevens

English: If you focus on what you left behind, you will never see what lies ahead.
Chinese: 如果你只顾回头看，你就永远无法看到前路有什么。
Author: 《美食总动员》

English: I have always regarded myself as the pillar of my life.
Chinese: 我一直认为，我才是我人生的中流砥柱。
Author: 梅丽尔·斯特里普

English: Nothing great in the world has been accomplished without passion.
Chinese: 世上没有任何伟业的成就能够离得开激情。
Author: 黑格尔

English: Instead of wondering when your next vacation is, maybe you should set up a life you don't need to escape from.
Chinese: 与其期盼下一次假期，不如创造一种不需要逃离的生活。
Author: Seth Godin

English: They can because they think they can.
Chinese: 他们可以，是因为他们相信自己可以。
Author: Virgil

English: The world is extremely interesting to a joyful soul.
Chinese: 对于欢欣的灵魂而言，世界充满了奇趣。
Author: Alexandra Stoddard

English: Success is not the key to happiness. Happiness is the key to success.
Chinese: 成功并不是快乐的关键，快乐才是成功的关键。
Author: Albert Schweitzer

English: Some people dream of success, while other people get up and make it happen.
Chinese: 有些人只是梦想去成功，而其他人却起身让梦想成真。
Author: Wayne Huizenga

English: To the world you may be one person, but to one person you may be the world.
Chinese: 对世界而言你或许只是某个人，但对某个人而言你或许是全世界。
Author: Dr. Seuss

English: It's never too late to be what you might have been.
Chinese: 成为你所要成为的人，永远都不嫌迟。
Author: George Eliot

English: Faith is the bird that feels the light and sings when the dawn is still dark.
Chinese: 信念是一只鸟，在黎明仍昏暗之时，就受光明引领而歌唱。
Author: 泰戈尔

English: If you have the ability to love, love yourself first.
Chinese: 假如你有去爱的能力，请先好好爱你自己。
Author: Charles Bukowski

English: Everyone needs a house to live in, but a supportive family is what builds a home.
Chinese: 人人都需要有屋栖身，但拥有支持自己的家人才是有了家。
Author: Anthony Liccione

English: Encourage yourself, believe in yourself and love yourself. Never doubt who you are.
Chinese: 你要鼓励自己、相信自己、爱自己。永远别怀疑你是谁。
Author: Stephanie Lahart

English: Love is what you've been through with somebody.
Chinese: 爱，就是你和某个人一起经历的一切。
Author: James Thurber

English: Always be a first-rate version of yourself, instead of a second-rate version of somebody else.
Chinese: 永远要做第一流的自己，而不是第二流的他人。
Author: Judy Garland

English: Well done is better than well said.
Chinese: 说得好，不如做得好。
Author: Benjamin Franklin

English: The beauty seen, is partly in him who sees it.
Chinese: 所见之美，部分存在于观众眼中。
Author: Christian N. Bovee

English: You have to learn that if you start making sure you feel good, everything will be okay.
Chinese: 要明白，如果你让自己感觉好起来，一切就都会好起来。
Author: Ruben Studdard

English: The way we talk to our children becomes their inner voice.
Chinese: 我们跟孩子说话的方式，会变成他们内心的声音。
Author: Peggy O'Mara

English: Life is a pure flame, and we live by an invisible sun within us.
Chinese: 生命是一束纯净的火焰，我们依靠内心看不见的太阳而存在。
Author: Sir Thomas Browne

English: Never give up. Expect only the best from life and take action to get it.
Chinese: 永远不要言弃。要永远只期待最好的事物，并为之付出行动。
Author: Catherine Pulsifer

English: While there's life, there is hope.
Chinese: 生命不息，希望不止。
Author: Stephen Hawking

English: It's easy to harden your heart. But to open it, that's the toughest thing you can do.
Chinese: 让心硬起来很容易，而敞开心扉，才是最难办到的。
Author: 《乐高大电影2》

English: Everyone shines, given the right lighting.
Chinese: 在合适的光源下，每个人都会发光。
Author: Susan Cain

English: Your relationship with yourself sets the tone for every other relationship you have.
Chinese: 你和你自己的关系，会奠定你其他任何一段关系的基调。
Author: Robert Holden

English: Success is what comes after you stop making excuses.
Chinese: 当你不再找借口，成功才会到来。
Author: Luis Galarza

English: Gardens are not made by sitting in the shade.
Chinese: 光在树荫下坐着，是建不成花园的。
Author: Rudyard Kipling

English: Live each day as if your life had just begun.
Chinese: 把每天，都当作生命刚开始一样去过吧！
Author: Johann Wolfgang Von Goethe

English: If you have to put someone on a pedestal, put teachers. They are society’s heroes.
Chinese: 如果必须推举偶像，那就推举老师吧，他们是社会的英雄。
Author: Guy Kawasaki

English: One of the best things in life is seeing a smile on a person's face and knowing that you put it there.
Chinese: 人生最美妙的事情，莫过于看到他人脸上的笑容，是因你而起。
Author: Lisa Drakeford

English: One never knows what each day is going to bring. The important thing is to be open and ready for it.
Chinese: 谁也不知道每一天都会带来什么。重要的是要敞开心扉，做好准备。
Author: Henry Moore

English: Friendship is the breathing rose, with sweets in every fold.
Chinese: 友谊是鲜活的玫瑰，每一道褶皱里都溢着甜香。
Author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.

English: Education is not the filling of a pail, but the lighting of a fire.
Chinese: 教育不是注满一桶水，而是点燃一把火。
Author: William Butler Yeats

English: It is love that will heal you. It is what heals us all.
Chinese: 爱会治愈你，会治愈我们所有人。
Author: 《沉睡魔咒2》

English: Growth begins when we begin to accept our own weakness.
Chinese: 成长始于接受自己的弱点。
Author: Jean Vanier

English: Rivers know this: there is no hurry. We shall get there some day.
Chinese: 河流知道这一点：无需匆忙。我们终有一日会到达。
Author: A. A. Milne

English: There is meaning in every journey that is unknown to the traveler.
Chinese: 每段旅程里都有不为旅行者所知的意义。
Author: Dietrich Bonhoeffer

English: Speak your mind even if your voice shakes.
Chinese: 勇敢说出你的想法，哪怕声音会颤抖。
Author: Maggie Kuhn

English: You know it's love when all you want is that person to be happy, even if you're not part of their happiness.
Chinese: 爱是，你只想要对方快乐，即使这快乐里不包括你。
Author: Julia Roberts

English: When life is sweet, say thank you and celebrate. And when life is bitter, say thank you and grow.
Chinese: 日子愉快时，道声谢谢，庆贺吧；日子苦难时，道声谢谢，成长吧。
Author: Shauna Niequist

English: Autumn, the year's last, loveliest smile.
Chinese: 秋，四季流转中最后一抹、亦是最美的微笑。
Author: William Cullen Bryant

English: Twenty years from now you will be more disappointed by the things that you didn't do than by the ones you did do.
Chinese: 二十年后，比起你做过的事，你会更遗憾于那些你没有去做的事。
Author: H. Jackson Brown Jr.

English: Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
Chinese: 你想要的一切，都在恐惧的彼端。
Author: George Addair

English: You may forget with whom you laughed, but you will never forget with whom you wept.
Chinese: 你可能会忘记和你一同笑过的人，却会永远记得和你一同哭过的人。
Author: Kahlil Gibran

English: The best day of your life is the one on which you decide your life is your own.
Chinese: 你生命中最美好的一天，就是你决定让你的人生属于你自己的那一天。
Author: Bob Moawad

English: Don't tell me the sky's the limit when there are footprints on the moon.
Chinese: 别对我说天空就是极限，毕竟连月球上都有了人类的脚印。
Author: Paul Brandt

English: Until you start believing in yourself, you ain't gonna have a life.
Chinese: 直到你开始相信自己，你的人生才真正开始。
Author: Rocky Balboa

English: A poet is a man who puts up a ladder to a star and climbs it while playing a violin.
Chinese: 诗人就是对着星空搭起天梯，然后边向上爬边拉小提琴的人。
Author: Edmond de Goncourt

English: Do you want to meet the love of your life? Look in the mirror.
Chinese: 想见见你的毕生所爱吗？看看镜中吧。
Author: Byron Katie

English: Travel and change of place impart new vigor to the mind.
Chinese: 去新的地方旅行，能让思维焕发新的活力。
Author: Seneca

English: A warm smile is the universal language of kindness.
Chinese: 温暖的笑容是放之四海皆准的善意表达。
Author: William Arthur Ward

English: Let your joy be in your journey — not in some distant goal.
Chinese: 让你的喜悦来自旅途中，而非一个遥远的目标。
Author: Tim Cook

English: An animal's eyes have the power to speak a great language.
Chinese: 动物的眼睛有一种神奇的力量，诉说着千言万语。
Author: Martin Buber

English: To accept ourselves as we are means to value our imperfections as much as our perfections.
Chinese: 所谓接受自己，意味着既重视自己的完美，也珍视自己的不完美。
Author: Sandra Bierig

English: The most beautiful discovery true friends make is that they can grow separately without growing apart.
Chinese: 朋友间最美妙的经历，莫过于成长道路不同，却并不因此生出隔阂。
Author: Elizabeth Foley

English: To fall in love with yourself is the first secret to happiness.
Chinese: 爱上自己是通往幸福的第一条奥秘。
Author: Robert Morley

English: The secret of discipline is motivation. When a man is sufficiently motivated, discipline will take care of itself.
Chinese: 自律的关键是动机，当一个人的动力足够时，他自然就能自律。
Author: Sir Alexander Paterson

English: We don’t want to tell our dreams. We want to show them.
Chinese: 我们不想把梦想说出来，而是想展现出来。
Author: Cristiano Ronaldo

English: Life isn't tied with a bow, but it's still a gift.
Chinese: 生活没有打上蝴蝶结，但它仍是一份礼物。
Author: Regina Brett

English: True self-discovery begins where your comfort zone ends.
Chinese: 真正的自我发现，始于你踏出了你的舒适区。
Author: Adam Braun

English: Don’t settle for what life gives you; make life better and build something.
Chinese: 不要满足于生活赋予你的，要有所创造，让人生变得更好。
Author: Ashton Kutcher

English: Youth is happy because it has the capacity to see beauty. Anyone who keeps the ability to see beauty never grows old.
Chinese: 青春之欢愉在于发现美的能力。而所有能发现美的人，会永远年轻。
Author: Franz Kafka

English: We can't all be heroes, because somebody has to sit on the curb and applaud when they go by.
Chinese: 我们不可能都成为英雄，总得有人在英雄走过的时候坐在路边鼓掌。
Author: Will Rogers

English: I am not afraid of tomorrow for I have seen yesterday and I love today.
Chinese: 我不害怕明天，因为我经历过昨天，又热爱今天。
Author: William Allen White

English: It took me 17 years and 114 days to become an overnight success.
Chinese: 我花了17年又114天的时间才在一夕之间成功。
Author: Lionel Messi

English: The minute you think, 'Oh, this is how life is', life finds a way of surprising you.
Chinese: 当你想着“哦，生活就是这样的”的时候，生活总会给你带来惊喜。
Author: 《爱宠大机密2》

English: So often people are working hard at the wrong thing. Working on the right thing is probably more important than working hard.
Chinese: 很多时候人们努力错了方向，在对的事情上努力可能比努力本身还重要。
Author: Caterina Fake

English: I'm not afraid of storms, for I'm learning how to sail my ship.
Chinese: 我不惧怕暴风雨，因为我正在学习如何驾驭我的船。
Author: 《小妇人》

English: If everything was perfect, you would never learn and you would never grow.
Chinese: 如果一切皆完美，你就永远不会学到东西，永远不会成长。
Author: Beyonce Knowles

English: Dew turns into frost since tonight; the moon viewed at home is more bright.
Chinese: 露从今夜白，月是故乡明。
Author: 杜甫《月夜忆舍弟》（许渊冲 译）

English: Be careful how you judge people, most of all friends. You don’t sum up a man’s life in one moment.
Chinese: 小心你是怎么评判他人的，尤其是朋友。你不能在片刻间总结一个人的一生。
Author: Al Pacino

English: Just trust yourself, then you will know how to live.
Chinese: 相信自己就对了，你将知道如何过日子。
Author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

English: What is right is not always popular, and what is popular is not always right.
Chinese: 对的事不见得都受欢迎，受欢迎的事不见得都是对的。
Author: Albert Einstein

English: You don’t love someone because they’re perfect. You love them in spite of the fact that they’re not.
Chinese: 不是因为一个人完美你才爱，而是即使那人不完美你也会去爱。
Author: Jodi Picoult

English: You've always had the power my dear, you just had to learn it for yourself.
Chinese: 其实你一直有那份力量，你只是需要学着去使用它。
Author: 《绿野仙踪》

English: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
Chinese: 昨天的我聪明，所以我想改变世界；今天的我明智，所以我选择改变自己。
Author: Rumi

English: That was my way of getting through difficult times of low confidence - hard work.
Chinese: 克服自信低潮的艰难时期，我只用一个方法：努力。
Author: David Beckham

English: Happiness adds and multiplies, as we divide it with others.
Chinese: 与他人分享快乐，我们会收获加倍的快乐。
Author: A. Nielsen

English: Dreams are like stars. You may never touch them, but if you follow them, they will lead you to your destiny.
Chinese: 梦想就像星星。也许你永远无法触碰，但如果你跟随它们，它们将引领你找到人生的路。
Author: Liam Payne

English: How lucky I am to have something that makes saying goodbye so hard.
Chinese: 能拥有一些难以割舍的东西，这是多么幸运啊。
Author: A.A. Milne

English: Life's a mixed bag, no matter who you are.
Chinese: 生活总是喜忧参半，无论你是谁。
Author: 《时空恋旅人》

English: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
Chinese: 你不去射门的话，就百分之百进不了球。
Author: Wayne Gretzky

English: Never regret. If it's good, it's wonderful. If it's bad, it's experience.
Chinese: 永远别去后悔。若结果美好，那很精彩。若结果糟糕，那是经历。
Author: Victoria Holt

English: You make a life out of what you have, not what you're missing.
Chinese: 你是靠自己所拥有的，而不是所缺少的来过你的人生。
Author: Kate Morton

English: Nothing is so strong as gentleness, nothing so gentle as real strength.
Chinese: 没有什么比温柔更有力量，也没有什么比真正的力量更温柔。
Author: Saint Francis de Sales

English: Love recognizes no barriers. It jumps hurdles, leaps fences, penetrates walls to arrive at its destination full of hope.
Chinese: 爱情不识藩篱。它将跨栏杆、越栅栏、穿围墙，满怀憧憬地抵达终点。
Author: Maya Angelou

English: You do not write your life with words. You write it with actions.
Chinese: 你不是用文字来书写你的人生的，而是用行动。
Author: Patrick Ness

English: It is our privilege and our adventure to discover our own special light.
Chinese: 去发现属于自己的独特光芒吧。这是我们的特权，也是我们的冒险。
Author: Mary Dunbar

English: Regardless of who you are or what you have been, you can be what you want to be.
Chinese: 无论你的现在和过去如何，你都可以决定你的将来。
Author: W. Clement Stone

English: The bravest sight in the world is to see a great man struggling against adversity.
Chinese: 世界上最勇敢的景象，便是勇者无畏地与逆境搏斗。
Author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

English: A multitude of small delights constitute happiness.
Chinese: 幸福就是许多小确幸的总和。
Author: Charles Baudelaire

English: There was never a night or a problem that could defeat sunrise or hope.
Chinese: 黑夜永远无法阻止日出，困难也绝不会战胜希望。
Author: Bernard Williams

English: You know you're in love when you can't fall asleep because reality is finally better than your dreams.
Chinese: 当你终于因为现实比梦境更美而无法入睡时，你便是陷入了爱情。
Author: Dr. Seuss

English: We cannot change anything until we accept it.
Chinese: 我们无法改变任何事，直到我们接受它的存在。
Author: Carl Jung

English: One can never consent to creep when one feels an impulse to soar.
Chinese: 一个人内心有了飞翔的冲动，就不会满足于在地上匍匐。
Author: Helen Keller

English: Enjoy your youth. You'll never be younger than you are at this very moment.
Chinese: 享受年轻时光吧！下一刻的你再不会有此刻的青春。
Author: Chad Sugg

English: There is no chance, no destiny, no fate, that can hinder or control the firm resolve of a determined soul.
Chinese: 对于下定决心的人来说，任何机遇、命数或运气都无法阻挠、控制其意志。
Author: Ella Wheeler Wilcox

English: The way to get things done is not to mind who gets the credit for doing them.
Chinese: 把事情做好的方法，是不去在意谁会因此得到赞誉。
Author: Benjamin Jowett

English: True love comes quietly, without banners or flashing lights.
Chinese: 真爱都是悄然降临，既不旗幡招展，也不灯火辉煌。
Author: Erich Segal

English: Time is a slippery thing: lose hold of it once, and its string might sail out of your hands forever.
Chinese: 时光狡黠，稍一松手，它便永远地从你指缝中流逝了。
Author: Anthony Doerr

English: The first step toward happiness is to determine to be happy.
Chinese: 迈向快乐的第一步，是怀有要快乐起来的决心。
Author: George Hodges

English: It's not whether you get knocked down, it's whether you get up.
Chinese: 倒下多少次并不重要，重要的是你每次是否会重新站起来。
Author: Vince Lombardi

English: If you have good thoughts they will shine out of your face like sunbeams and you will always look lovely.
Chinese: 你若思想美好，面容就会如阳光般灿烂，看上去永远可爱迷人。
Author: Roald Dahl

English: There is a morning inside you waiting to burst open into light.
Chinese: 在你心内，有一个黎明在等待破晓。
Author: Rumi

English: That it will never come again is what makes life sweet.
Chinese: 生活不会重来，这正是它美好的原因。
Author: Emily Dickinson

English: The more grateful I am, the more beauty I see.
Chinese: 我越是感恩，我看到的美就越多。
Author: Mary Davis

English: People make mistakes. It's why they put rubbers on the ends of pencils.
Chinese: 人都会犯错误，这就是为何他们会在铅笔上装橡皮头。
Author: 《伦敦生活》

English: The best way to predict future is to create it.
Chinese: 预测未来的最好方式是创造未来。
Author: Peter Drucker

English: Love is not finding someone to live with. It's finding someone you can't live without.
Chinese: 爱情，不是找一个与你一起生活的人，而是要找一个于你不可或缺的人。
Author: Rafael Ortiz

English: Distance never separates two hearts that really care.
Chinese: 距离，从不会分开两颗真正在乎彼此的心。 ​​​​
Author: Henri Nouwen

English: If you only shine light on your flaws, all your perfects will dim.
Chinese: 如果只看到自己的缺点，你所有的美好都会黯然失色。
Author: Colleen Hoover

English: Climb mountains not so the world can see you, but so you can see the world.
Chinese: 爬上山顶并不是为了让世界看到你，而是为了让你看到整个世界。
Author: David McCullough Jr.

English: Regrets about the journey, maybe, but not the destination.
Chinese: 也许过程并不尽如人意，但别为自己有过目标而后悔。
Author: Nicholas Sparks

English: Happiness often sneaks in through a door you didn't know you left open.
Chinese: 幸福，往往从你不经意间打开的门中不期而至。
Author: John Barrymore

English: If life throws you a few bad notes or vibrations, don't let them interrupt or alter your song.
Chinese: 即便生活给了你一些不和谐的音符，也别让它们破坏你的人生之歌。
Author: Suzy Kassem

English: Every flower is a soul blossoming in nature.
Chinese: 每朵花都是大自然中绽放的灵魂。
Author: Gerard De Nerval

English: All cowardice comes from not loving or not loving well, which is the same thing.
Chinese: 所有的懦弱都出自于不爱或爱得不彻底，这两者一样。
Author: 《午夜巴黎》

English: One part of wisdom is knowing what you don't need anymore and letting it go.
Chinese: 有种智慧是知道自己不再需要什么，然后学会放手。
Author: Jane Fonda

English: Fear not that the life shall come to an end, but rather fear that it shall never have a beginning.
Chinese: 不要害怕你的生活会结束，应该担心你的生活从未真正开始过。
Author: John Henry Newman

English: You're braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
Chinese: 你比你想象中更勇敢，比你看起来更强大，也比你以为的更聪明。
Author: A.A. Milne

English: A bird doesn't sing because it has an answer, it sings because it has a song.
Chinese: 鸟儿歌唱不是因为它知道答案，而是因为它心中有一支歌。
Author: Maya Angelou

English: If you see someone without a smile, give them one of yours.
Chinese: 如果看见有人愁眉不展，就把你的微笑分享给他们吧！
Author: Dolly Parton

English: We lose ourselves in things we love. We find ourselves there, too.
Chinese: 我们会在所爱之事中失去自己，但也会在其中找到自己。
Author: Kristin Martz

English: All your life you wait, and then it finally comes, and are you ready?
Chinese: 你一生都在等待，当所等之事终于到来时，你是否准备好了？
Author: Anthony Doerr

English: Love one another, but make not a bond of love: let it rather be a moving sea between the shores of your souls.
Chinese: 相爱吧！但别让爱成为羁绊，爱应当是两个灵魂间涌动的海洋。
Author: Kahlil Gibran

English: Everyone wants to be appreciated, so if you appreciate someone, don't keep it a secret.
Chinese: 每个人都想被赏识，所以如果你欣赏一个人，别藏在心里。
Author: Mary Kay Ash

English: Sometimes our light goes out but is blown into flame by another human being.
Chinese: 有时我们心中的火焰会熄灭。但当遇到另一个人时，它又会再次燃烧起来。
Author: Albert Schweitzer

English: You'll find that life is still worthwhile, if you just smile.
Chinese: 微笑吧，你会发现，人间依旧值得。
Author: Charlie Chaplin

English: From now on, I'm gonna say yes—yes to love, yes to adventure, yes to life.
Chinese: 从今天起，我要积极接受一切，接受爱，迎接挑战，拥抱生活。
Author: 《生活大爆炸》

English: It's kind of fun to do the impossible.
Chinese: 去做不可能的事情，是相当有趣的。
Author: Walt Disney

English: Winter is on my head, but eternal spring is in my heart.
Chinese: 冬日已经降临，然而我心中有永恒的春天。
Author: Victor Hugo

English: One of the most important things you can do on this earth is to let people know they are not alone.
Chinese: 在这个世界上，你所能做的最重要的事情之一，就是让别人知道他们并不孤单。
Author: Shannon L. Alder

English: Art washes away from the soul the dust of everyday life.
Chinese: 艺术能洗去日常生活覆在灵魂上的尘埃。
Author: Pablo Picasso

English: Gifts of time and love are surely the basic ingredients of a truly merry Christmas.
Chinese: 最真挚且简单的圣诞祝福，就是以时间和爱为礼物。
Author: Peg Bracken

English: At Christmas play and make good cheer, for Christmas comes but once a year.
Chinese: 圣诞节就好好游戏和欢呼吧，因为圣诞节一年只有一次。
Author: Thomas Tusser

English: Forever is composed of nows.
Chinese: 永恒是由每一个当下组成的。
Author: Emily Dickinson

English: Acceptance is to love and embrace everything that we find within ourselves like a mother embraces her child.
Chinese: 所谓的接纳，就是去爱并拥抱我们内心的一切，像一个母亲拥抱自己的孩子一样。
Author: Swami Dhyan Giten

English: Work hard in silence, let your success be your noise.
Chinese: 在沉默中努力吧，让成功为你发声。
Author: Frank Ocean

English: Expect the best. Prepare for the worst. Capitalize on what comes.
Chinese: 要抱最大的希望，做最坏的打算，从结果中学习。
Author: Zig Ziglar

English: Love is just a word until someone comes along and gives it meaning.
Chinese: 爱不过是一个词而已，直到有一个人来到你面前，赋予它意义。
Author: Paulo Coelho

English: Tomorrow is the first blank page of a 365 page book. Write a good one.
Chinese: 新年之书有365张空白页，明天是第一页。书写美好的明天吧！
Author: Brad Paisley

English: For a new year to bring you something new, make a move, like a butterfly tearing its cocoon!
Chinese: 为了迎接，这充满新象的新的一年，像蝴蝶破茧那样行动起来吧！
Author: Mehmet Murat ildan

English: Love is a promise. Love is a souvenir. Once given, never forgotten. Never let it disappear.
Chinese: 爱是承诺，爱是纪念。一旦赋予，永不被遗忘。莫让爱消失。
Author: John Lennon

English: Wherever there is a human being, there is an opportunity for a kindness.
Chinese: 哪里有人，哪里就有良善的机会。
Author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

English: It's not that I'm so smart, it's just that I stay with problems longer.
Chinese: 不是我聪明，而是我会花更多的时间和问题待在一起。
Author: Albert Einstein

English: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
Chinese: 未来属于那些相信梦想之美的人。
Author: Eleanor Roosevelt

English: Winners lose more than losers, because they stay in the game.
Chinese: 胜利者比失败者输得场次更多，因为他们一直留在赛场上。
Author: Terry Paulson

English: The only limit to the height of your achievements is the reach of your dreams and your willingness to work hard for them.
Chinese: 唯一限制你成就高度的，是你梦想的限度，以及为之努力的意愿。
Author: Michelle Obama

English: The golden age is before us, not behind us.
Chinese: 黄金时代在我们面前，而不在我们背后。
Author: William Shakespeare

English: It never will rain roses. When we want to have more roses we must plant trees.
Chinese: 天上永远不会掉下玫瑰来，如果想要更多的玫瑰，必须自己种植。
Author: George Eliot

English: Imagination is the voice of daring.
Chinese: 想象力是大胆的体现。
Author: Henry Miller

English: In the end, it's not the years in your life that count. It's the life in your years.
Chinese: 到头来，你活了多少岁不算什么。重要的是你是如何度过这些岁月的。
Author: Abraham Lincoln

English: No problem can withstand the assault of sustained thinking.
Chinese: 没有问题能经得起不断思考的攻坚。
Author: Voltaire

English: Put your heart, mind, intellect and soul even to your smallest acts. This is the secret of success.
Chinese: 把你的全身心，灵魂都投入到你所做的最微小的事上。那是成功的秘诀。
Author: Swami Sivananda

English: Be happy, but never satisfied.
Chinese: 要快乐，但永远不要满足。
Author: Bruce Lee

English: You make a life out of what you have, not what you’re missing.
Chinese: 生活依靠的是自己所拥有的，而不是所缺少的东西。
Author: Kate Morton

English: We all die. The goal isn't to live forever, the goal is to create something that will.
Chinese: 人终有一死。活着并不是为了不朽，而是为了创造不朽。
Author: Chuck Palahniuk

English: Real magic in relationships means an absence of judgment of others.
Chinese: 良好人际关系的秘诀，在于不对他人做出评判。
Author: Wayne Dyer

English: Winners don't believe in fate like others do. They simply cannot accept defeat.
Chinese: 赢家不像他人那样相信命运。他们只是不能接受失败。
Author: David Silva

English: Activity is the only road to knowledge.
Chinese: 行动是通往知识的唯一道路。
Author: George Bernard Shaw

English: Action is the foundational key to all success.
Chinese: 行动是所有成功的根本。
Author: Pablo Picasso

English: Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear, not absence of fear.
Chinese: 勇敢并非没有恐惧，而是克服恐惧，战胜恐惧。
Author: Mark Twain

English: Darkness cannot drive out darkness; only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate; only love can do that.
Chinese: 黑暗无法驱走黑暗，唯有光明才能做到。仇恨无法驱除仇恨，唯有爱才能做到。
Author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

English: Perseverance is failing nineteen times and succeeding the twentieth.
Chinese: 十九次失败，到第二十次获得成功，这就叫坚持。
Author: Julie Andrews

English: You have to believe in yourself. That's the secret of success.
Chinese: 你必须相信自己，这是成功的秘诀。
Author: Charles Chaplin

English: Progress is the activity of today and the assurance of tomorrow.
Chinese: 进步是今天的动力、明日的保证。
Author: Emerson

English: There are no secrets to success. It is the result of preparation, hard work, and learning from failure.
Chinese: 成功没有诀窍。成功是筹备，苦干以及在失败中汲取教训的结果。
Author: Colin L. Powell

English: A day without laughter is a day wasted.
Chinese: 如果一天里没有欢笑，那这一天就被浪费了。
Author: Charlie Chaplin

English: That man is richest whose pleasures are cheapest.
Chinese: 能轻易获得快乐的人最富有。
Author: Henry David Thoreau

English: If winter comes, can spring be far behind?
Chinese: 冬天来了，春天还会远吗？
Author: P.B. Shelley

English: Positive thinking will let you do everything better than negative thinking will.
Chinese: 比起悲观，乐观会让你把所有事情做得更好。
Author: Zig Ziglar

English: You'll never be alone if you've got a book.
Chinese: 只要手捧书卷，你就永远不会感到孤独。
Author: Al Pacino

English: Happiness depends upon ourselves.
Chinese: 幸福与否我们自己说了算。
Author: Aristotle

English: Life is a mirror and will reflect back to the thinker what he thinks into it.
Chinese: 生活是一面镜子，会把你所想的反射出来。
Author: Ernest Holmes

English: One word frees us of all the weight and pain of life: That word is love.
Chinese: 有一个字能让我们摆脱生活的压力与痛苦，这个字就是“爱”。
Author: Sophocles

English: A real friend is one who walks in when the rest of the world walks out.
Chinese: 真正的朋友会在全世界与你为敌时站在你身边。
Author: Walter Winchell

English: To love oneself is the beginning of a lifelong romance.
Chinese: 爱自己是终身浪漫的开始。
Author: Oscar Wilde

English: The only way to have a friend is to be one.
Chinese: 获得朋友的唯一方法是成为别人的朋友。
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

English: That it will never come again is what makes life sweet.
Chinese: 生活不会重来，这正是它美好的原因。
Author: Emily Dickinson

English: If you would be loved, love, and be loveable.
Chinese: 如果你想要被爱，就要去爱，并要让自己值得被爱。
Author: Benjamin Franklin

English: The first duty of love is to listen.
Chinese: 爱的首要义务是倾听。
Author: Paul Tillich

English: Growth is the only evidence of life.
Chinese: 成长是生命的唯一证据。
Author: John Henry Newman

English: It didn’t matter how big our house was; it mattered that there was love in it.
Chinese: 房子多大并不重要，重要的是家中有爱。
Author: Peter Buffett

English: New year is the glittering light to brighten the dream-lined pathway of future.
Chinese: 新年如璀璨的灯光，照亮通向未来的梦想道路。
Author: Munia Khan

English: A happy family is but an earlier heaven.
Chinese: 幸福的家庭犹如人间天堂。
Author: George Bernard Shaw

English: Love isn't something you find. Love is something that finds you.
Chinese: 不是你找到了爱，而是爱找到了你。
Author: Loretta Young

English: Not he who has much is rich, but he who gives much.
Chinese: 拥有的多并不算富有，给予的多才算富有。
Author: Erich Fromm

English: Life is not merely being alive, but being well.
Chinese: 生活不只是活着，而是精彩地活着。
Author: Marcus Valerius Martialis

English: It always seems impossible until it's done.
Chinese: 事情未成功之前，总看似不可能完成。
Author: Nelson Mandela

English: I truly believe there's always a solution to every problem.
Chinese: 我确信，每个问题都有解决方案。
Author: Maira Kalman

English: It is not in the stars to hold our destiny but in ourselves.
Chinese: 掌握命运的是我们自己，而不是天上的星星。
Author: William Shakespeare

English: I never dreamed about success. I worked for it.
Chinese: 我从未梦想成功，我只向着成功努力。
Author: Estée Lauder

English: The foolish man seeks happiness in the distance, the wise grows it under his feet.
Chinese: 愚者追求远方的快乐，智者播种脚下的幸福。
Author: James Oppenheim

English: Only I can change my life. No one can do it for me.
Chinese: 能改变生活的只有我自己，没有人能替我改变。
Author: Carol Burnett

English: Nothing is more highly to be prized than the value of each day.
Chinese: 把握当下才是真。
Author: Johann Wolfgangvon Goethe

English: Never bend your head. Always hold it high. Look the world straight in the face.
Chinese: 永远不要垂下头。要高昂着头，直面这世界。
Author: Helen Keller

English: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
Chinese: 知生命之意者，可承生命之重。
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

English: The memories we make with our family are everything.
Chinese: 我们和家人一起创造的记忆最为重要。
Author: Candace Cameron Bure

English: If you think you can do it, you can.
Chinese: 如果你认为你能成功，你就能成功。
Author: John Burroughs

English: Marriage is not a ritual or an end. It is a long, intricate, intimate dance together and nothing matters more than your own sense of balance and your choice of partner.
Chinese: 婚姻不是仪式也不是终结，而是一支漫长、复杂、亲密的共舞。最重要的是你自己的平衡感和对舞伴的选择。
Author: Amy Bloom

English: Action may not always bring happiness; but there is no happiness without action.
Chinese: 行动不一定能带来快乐，但不行动一定不能。
Author: Benjamin Disraeli

English: Nothing is so common as the wish to be remarkable.
Chinese: 没有什么比希望不平凡而更平凡的了。
Author: Oliver Wendell Holmes

English: People are lonely because they build walls instead of bridges.
Chinese: 人们感到孤独，是因为他们为自己修起了围墙而不是桥梁。
Author: Joseph Fort Newton

English: One should eat to live, not live to eat.
Chinese: 人生应为生而食，不应为食而生。
Author: Moliere

English: The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
Chinese: 真正的智慧是知道自己一无所知。
Author: Socrates

English: Knowledge is of no value unless you put it into practice.
Chinese: 只有付诸实践，知识才有价值。
Author: Anton Chekhov

English: Action is the foundational key to all success.
Chinese: 行动是所有成功的根本。
Author: Pablo Picasso

English: There is no limit to what we, as women, can accomplish.
Chinese: 作为女性，没有什么是我们做不到的。
Author: Michelle Obama

English: Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
Chinese: 像你明天就会离世那样生活，像你可以永葆青春那样学习。
Author: Mahatma Gandhi

English: Definiteness of purpose is the starting point of all achievement.
Chinese: 目标明确是一切成功的起点。
Author: W. Clement Stone

English: Set your goals high, and don't stop till you get there.
Chinese: 树立远大的目标，不达目的誓不罢休。
Author: Bo Jackson

English: Trees are poems that the earth writes upon the sky.
Chinese: 绿树是大地谱于苍宇的诗篇。
Author: Kahlil Gibran

English: If you really want to do something, you'll find a way. If you don't, you'll find an excuse.
Chinese: 只要想做，就能找到办法；如果不想，找到的便只是借口。
Author: Jim Rohn

English: A man who dares to waste one hour of time has not discovered the value of life.
Chinese: 敢于浪费一个小时的人，没有发现生命的价值。
Author: Charles Darwin

English: The cure to boredom is curiosity. There is no cure for curiosity.
Chinese: 无聊的解药是好奇心，但好奇心没有解药。
Author: Dorothy Parker

English: A plant does not bear fruit without its stem.
Chinese: 没有茎干，植物就无法结果。
Author: Matshona Dhliwayo

English: Regret for the things we did can be tempered by time; it is regret for the things we did not do that is inconsolable.
Chinese: 若后悔既成之事，时间方可平抚，但若懊悔未竟之事，则永远无法缓和。
Author: Sydney J. Harris

English: A positive mind finds a way it can be done; A negative mind looks for all the ways it can't be done.
Chinese: 积极的人会去寻找任务的解决方案；消极的人会去寻找无法完成任务的各种理由。
Author: Napoleon Hill

English: If you wish to reach the highest, begin at the lowest.
Chinese: 若想到达最高处，先从最低处做起。
Author: Publilius Syrus

English: Blossom by blossom the spring begins.
Chinese: 花开了，春天也来了。
Author: Algernon Charles Swinburne

English: If you are always trying to be normal, you will never know how amazing you can be.
Chinese: 你若总想平平凡凡，就永远不知道自己能有多出色。
Author: Maya Angelou

English: Failure after long perseverance is much grander than never to have a striving good enough to be called a failure.
Chinese: 相比未有过可称之为失败的努力，坚持不懈之后的失败要伟大得多。
Author: George Eliot

English: It doesn't matter where you are, you are nowhere compared to where you can go.
Chinese: 跟你可以去到的地方相比，你身处何处并不重要。
Author: Bob Proctor

English: Think of all the beauty still left around you and be happy.
Chinese: 想想仍然留在你身边的美丽事物，开心起来吧。
Author: Anne Frank

English: How you think about a problem is more important than the problem itself, so always think positively.
Chinese: 如何看待问题远比问题本身来得重要，所以永远要正向思考。
Author: Norman Vincent Peale

English: Marriage is a form of discipline involving two people committing to a certain lifestyle and set of boundaries.
Chinese: 婚姻是一种行为准则：两人承诺履行某种生活方式并遵守一套行为边界。
Author: David Khalil

English: We awaken in others the same attitude of mind we hold toward them.
Chinese: 我们如何对待他人，他人就如何对待我们。
Author: Elbert Hubbard

English: If someone tells you "you can't", they're showing you their limits, not yours.
Chinese: 如果有人说“你做不到”，他们展现的是自己的极限，不是你的极限。
Author: Dwayne Johnson

English: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
Chinese: 你不必生而伟大，但要开始变得伟大。
Author: Zig Ziglar

English: Continuous improvement is better than delayed perfection.
Chinese: 持续的改进，胜过延迟的完美。
Author: Mark Twain

English: Believe you can and you're half way there.
Chinese: 相信你能行，你就成功了一半。
Author: Theodore Roosevelt

English: The most important kind of freedom is to be what you really are.
Chinese: 论自由，最重要的就是做你自己。
Author: Jim Morrison

English: Challenges are what make life interesting and overcoming them is what makes life meaningful.
Chinese: 挑战让生活趣味盎然，战胜挑战让生活意义非凡。
Author: Joshua J. Marine

English: Whatever you believe with feeling becomes your reality.
Chinese: 无论什么，只要发自心底地坚信，都能成真。
Author: Brian Tracy

English: A drizzling rain falls like tears on the Mourning Day; The mourner's heart is going to break on his way.
Chinese: 清明时节雨纷纷，路上行人欲断魂。
Author: 《清明》，杜牧（许渊冲译）

English: A person who never made a mistake never tried anything new.
Chinese: 一个从不犯错误的人，一定从来没有尝试过任何新鲜事物。
Author: Albert Einstein

English: Happiness adds and multiplies, as we divide it with others.
Chinese: 与他人分享快乐，我们会收获加倍的快乐。
Author: A. Nielsen

English: You can't be paralyzed by fear of failure or you will never push yourself.
Chinese: 你绝不能为失败的恐惧所吓倒，否则你将永远不会前进。
Author: Arnold Schwarzenegger

English: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
Chinese: 每一次与自然同行，都会有意外的收获。
Author: John Muir

English: Refrain from excess.
Chinese: 凡事不要过度。
Author: Charles Augustin Sainte-Beuve

English: All change is not growth, as all movement is not forward.
Chinese: 不是所有的改变都是成长，正如不是所有的运动都是前进。
Author: Ellen Glasgow

English: The real test of good manners is to be able to put up with bad manners pleasantly.
Chinese: 对礼貌真正的考验在于能否愉快地忍受粗鲁。
Author: Kahlil Gilbran

English: It is not beauty that endears, it's love that makes us see beauty.
Chinese: 并非美丽招人爱，而是爱让我们看到了美丽。
Author: Leo Tolstoy

English: Press forward. Do not stop, do not linger in your journey, but strive for the mark set before you.
Chinese: 继续前行！不要停下脚步！不要在路上流连！向着前面的目标奋进！
Author: George Whitefield

English: Life is 10% what happens to me and 90% of how I react to it.
Chinese: 生活的一成是发生在我身上的事情，剩下的九成取决于我如何应对。
Author: Charles Swindoll

English: I'm a greater believer in luck, and I find the harder I work the more I have of it.
Chinese: 我很相信运气，事实上我发现越努力，我的运气越好。
Author: Thomas Jefferson

English: Don't watch the clock; do what it does. Keep going.
Chinese: 别盯着时钟看，要像时钟一样不停前进。
Author: Sam Levenson

English: Limitations live only in our minds. But if we use our imaginations, our possibilities become limitless.
Chinese: 思维有限，但我们的想象力能造就无限可能。
Author: Jamie Paolinetti

English: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
Chinese: 善良是一种语言，失聪者能听到，目盲者能看到。
Author: Mark Twain

English: The greatest pleasure in life is doing what people say you cannot do.
Chinese: 人生一大乐事就是做到别人认为你做不到的事。
Author: Walter Bagehot

English: A river cuts through rock, not because of its power, but because of its persistence.
Chinese: 河流可以切碎岩石，并非因其力大无穷，乃是因为坚持不懈。
Author: James N. Watkins

English: The difference between stupidity and genius is that genius has its limits.
Chinese: 愚蠢和天赋的区别在于，天赋是有极限的。
Author: Albert Einstein

English: If we had no winter, the spring would not be so pleasant; if we did not sometimes taste of adversity, prosperity would not be so welcome.
Chinese: 不历严冬，春天不迷人；不尝艰辛，成功无欣喜。
Author: Anne Bradstreet

English: Failure is not the opposite of success; it's part of success.
Chinese: 失败不是成功的反义词，它是成功的一部分。
Author: Arianna Huffington

English: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
Chinese: 获得知识并不够，还要去应用；立下志向也不够，还要去行动。
Author: Goethe

English: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
Chinese: 前进的秘诀是着手开始。
Author: Mark Twain

English: Don't criticize what you can't understand.
Chinese: 不懂的，不要随意批判。
Author: Bob Dylan

English: If you can't fly then run, if you can't run then walk, if you can't walk then crawl, but whatever you do you have to keep moving forward.
Chinese: 如果不能飞，那就跑；如果跑不动，那就走；实在走不了，那就爬。无论做什么，你都要勇往直前。
Author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

English: Always do your best. What you plant now, you will harvest later.
Chinese: 永远要全力以赴，今日播下的种子，终会得到丰收。
Author: Og Mandino

English: Good manners and soft words have brought many a difficult thing to pass.
Chinese: 礼貌的行为和温柔的话语会让很多难题迎刃而解。
Author: Sir John Vanbrugh

English: I am not a product of my circumstances. I am a product of my decisions.
Chinese: 我并非由环境造就，乃是由我所做出的决定造就。
Author: Stephen Covey

English: It is labor indeed that puts the difference on everything.
Chinese: 劳动让一切变得不同。
Author: John Locke

English: Weak people revenge. Strong people forgive. Intelligent People Ignore.
Chinese: 软弱的人寻求复仇；坚强的人选择原谅；聪明的人则会无视。
Author: Albert Einstein

English: The farther backward you can look, the farther forward you can see.
Chinese: 你回首看得越远，你向前也会看得越远。
Author: Winston Churchill

English: A good education is the most important gift we can give our young people.
Chinese: 良好的教育是我们能赠予年轻人最重要的礼物。
Author: Nicola Sturgeon

English: Summertime is always the best of what might be.
Chinese: 万物最美的一面，总在夏季展现。
Author: Charles Bowden

English: Here's to books, the cheapest vacation you can buy.
Chinese: 你能买到的最便宜的假期是书籍。
Author: Charlaine Harris

English: All your dreams can come true if you have the courage to pursue them.
Chinese: 只要有勇气追逐梦想，所有的梦想都可以成真。
Author: Walt Disney

English: Education costs money. But then so does ignorance.
Chinese: 教育很费钱，无知也费钱。
Author: Sir Claus Moser

English: A mother's love is more beautiful than any fresh flower.
Chinese: 母爱比任何鲜花都要美丽。
Author: Debasish Mridha

English: Do not fear to be eccentric in opinion, for every opinion now accepted was once eccentric.
Chinese: 不要害怕想法怪异，现在被接受的想法曾经都是怪异的。
Author: Bertrand Russell

English: We may encounter many defeats but we must not be defeated.
Chinese: 我们可能会遭遇许多失败，但绝不能被它们击败。
Author: Maya Angelou

English: Either you run the day or the day runs you.
Chinese: 你不主宰时光，时光就会主宰你。
Author: Jim Rohn

English: Successful and unsuccessful people do not vary greatly in their abilities. They vary in their desires to reach their potential.
Chinese: 一个人成功与否，很大程度上并不取决于能力，而在于渴望发挥自身潜力的程度。
Author: John C. Maxwell

English: What would life be if we had no courage to attempt anything?
Chinese: 如果我们没有勇气去尝试，生活会变成什么样子呢？
Author: Vincent van Gogh

English: Love is like war: easy to begin but very hard to stop.
Chinese: 爱如战争，开始容易结束难。
Author: H. L. Mencken

English: A random act of kindness, no matter how small, can make a tremendous impact on someone else's life.
Chinese: 你的一次无心的善举，不论多么微不足道，都可能对他人的生活产生巨大影响。
Author: Roy T. Bennett

English: It is in your moments of decision that your destiny is shaped.
Chinese: 命运形成于你做出决定的那一刻。
Author: Tony Robbins

English: Either move or be moved.
Chinese: 要么主动寻求改变，要么被动接受改变。
Author: Ezra Pound

English: People rarely succeed unless they have fun in what they are doing.
Chinese: 若不能在所做之事中寻到快乐，人便难以成功。
Author: Dale Carnegie

English: When two people love each other, they don't look at each other, they look in the same direction.
Chinese: 两人相爱时，他们不会对视，而是会看向同一个方向。
Author: Ginger Rogers

English: For success, attitude is equally as important as ability.
Chinese: 要想成功，态度同能力一样重要。
Author: Sir Walter Scott

English: Without deviation from the norm, progress is not possible.
Chinese: 不偏离常规，就无法取得进步。
Author: Frank Zappa

English: Talent hits a target no one else can hit; Genius hits a target no one else can see.
Chinese: 能者达人所不达，智者达人所未见。
Author: Arthur Schopenhauer

English: Curiosity is the lust of the mind.
Chinese: 好奇心是大脑的渴望。
Author: Thomas Hobbes

English: When you arise in the morning, think of what a precious privilege it is to be alive - to breathe, to think, to enjoy, to love.
Chinese: 早上醒来时，想想活着是多么珍贵的特权——可以呼吸、思考、享受、去爱。
Author: Marcus Aurelius

English: Be not simply good — be good for something.
Chinese: 不要一味地善良，要有原则地善良。
Author: Thoreau

English: To accomplish great things, we must not only act, but also dream; not only plan, but also believe.
Chinese: 想要成就一番事业，不仅要行动，还要敢于梦想；不仅要做计划，还要抱有信念。
Author: Anatole France

English: The best cure for the body is a quiet mind.
Chinese: 对身体最好的治疗就是让头脑安静。
Author: Napoléon

English: Problems are guidelines, not stop signs!
Chinese: 问题不是止步的信号，而是前进的指引。
Author: Robert H. Schuller

English: I believe every human has a finite number of heartbeats. I don't intend to waste any of mine.
Chinese: 我相信每个人的心跳次数有限，所以我不想浪费任何一下。
Author: Neil Armstrong

English: The more one judges, the less one loves.
Chinese: 评判得越多，爱得越少。
Author: Honore de Balzac

English: Children are not things to be molded, but are people to be unfolded.
Chinese: 孩子不是有待铸造的物料，而是有待启发的人。
Author: Jess Lair

English: Talent without working hard is nothing.
Chinese: 没有勤奋的才华一无是处。
Author: Cristiano Ronaldo

English: Real generosity toward the future lies in giving all to the present.
Chinese: 将一切奉献给当下，就是对未来的真正慷慨。
Author: Albert Camus

English: All life is an experiment. The more experiments you make the better.
Chinese: 生活就是实验，实验的次数越多你就做得越好。
Author: Emerson

English: Small deeds done are better than great deeds planned.
Chinese: 已经完成的小事，胜于计划中的大事。
Author: Peter Marshall

English: The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
Chinese: 你注定只会成为你决心要变成的那个人。
Author: Emerson

English: We are all different. Don't judge, understand instead.
Chinese: 每个人都不同。别去评断别人，要去理解别人。
Author: Roy T. Bennett

English: If you fell down yesterday, stand up today.
Chinese: 如果昨天倒下了，今天就站起来。
Author: H. G. Wells

English: Tomorrow belongs to those who can hear it coming.
Chinese: 明天属于那些能听见它来临的人。
Author: David Bowie

English: The way to love anything is to realize that it may be lost.
Chinese: 害怕失去之时，就是爱开始之日。​
Author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

English: The greatest of faults, I should say, is to be conscious of none.
Chinese: 我必须得说，最大的过错，莫过于看不到任何过错。
Author: Thomas Carlyle

English: Don't get so busy making a living that you forget to make a life.
Chinese: 千万别为忙着营生而忘了享受人生。
Author: Dolly Parton

English: No person is your friend who demands your silence, or denies your right to grow.
Chinese: 要求你沉默，或拒绝给予你成长机会的人，绝不是你的朋友。
Author: Alice Walker

English: Kutsu's prose song hangs with the sun and moon, King So's terraced palace is now but barren hill.
Chinese: 屈平辞赋悬日月，楚王台榭空山丘。
Author: 李白《江上吟》

English: In every person who comes near you look for what is good and strong.
Chinese: 对于你遇见的每一个人，要寻找他的优点和强项。
Author: John Ruskin

English: Don't bother just to be better than others. Try to be better than yourself.
Chinese: 不要为了比别人强而烦恼，要努力比自己强。
Author: William Faulkner

English: It's tempting to want to live in the past. It's familiar. It's comfortable, but it's where fossils come from.
Chinese: 活在过去是一件很诱人的事，因为它既熟悉又舒适。但是化石就是这么来的。
Author: Mark Waid

English: As long as you're being a copycat, you will never be the best copycat.
Chinese: 你只要在模仿他人，就做不到最好。
Author: Eric Thomas

English: Love ceases to be a pleasure when it ceases to be a secret.
Chinese: 爱情一旦不神秘了，也就失去了它的乐趣。
Author: Aphra Behn

English: The heart of a father is the masterpiece of nature.
Chinese: 父亲的心是自然的杰作。
Author: Antoine François Prévost

English: I love how summer just wraps its arms around you like a warm blanket.
Chinese: 夏天就像一张温暖的毯子抱着你，我喜欢这一点。
Author: Kellie Elmore

English: The successful man will profit from his mistakes and try again in a different way.
Chinese: 成功人士会从其错误中获益，然后另辟蹊径再做尝试。
Author: Dale Carnegie

English: Working hard for something we don't care about is called stress; working hard for something we love is called passion.
Chinese: 努力做自己不在乎的事叫做压力；努力做自己喜爱的事叫做激情。
Author: Simon Sinek

English: Patience, persistence and perspiration make an unbeatable combination for success.
Chinese: 耐心、坚持和汗水是取得成功的无敌组合。
Author: Napoleon Hill

English: Do you want to know who you are? Don't ask. Act! Action will delineate and define you.
Chinese: 你想知道自己是什么样的人？不要去追问，行动起来！行动会描绘和定义你的模样。
Author: Thomas Jefferson

English: Love keeps the cold out better than a cloak.
Chinese: 相比斗篷，爱情更能驱走寒冷。
Author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

English: Pure love and suspicion cannot dwell together: at the door where the latter enters, the former makes its exit.
Chinese: 纯洁的爱情和猜疑水火不容：起了疑心，就会丢了爱情。
Author: Alexandre Dumas

English: Love is like quicksilver in the hand. Leave the fingers open and it stays. Clutch it and it darts away.
Chinese: 爱情就如手中的水银。张开手指，它就留在手中；一旦攥紧，它就飞快离开。
Author: Dorothy Parker

English: The 100th Anniversary of the Founding of The Communist Party of China
Chinese: 庆祝中国共产党成立100周年
Author: 中国文明网

Chinese: 庆祝中国共产党成立100周年
Author: 中国文明网

Chinese: 庆祝中国共产党成立100周年

Chinese: 庆祝中国共产党成立100周年
