English: Success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which he has overcome.
Chinese: 衡量成功的标准不是看一个人在生活中所处的地位，而是看他所克服的障碍。
Author: Booker T. Washington

English: A man is a success if he gets up in the morning and goes to bed at night and in between does what he wants to do.
Chinese: 成功的生活就是早上起床，晚上睡觉，白天做自己想做的事。
Author: Bob Dylan

English: However difficult life may seem, there is always something you can do and succeed at.
Chinese: 无论生活看起来多么困难，总有一些你可以做，并能获得成功的事情。
Author: Stephen Hawking

English: Your life is a reflection of your thoughts. If you change your thinking, you change your life.
Chinese: 你的生活是你思维的反映。如果你改变了你的思维，你就改变了你的生活。
Author: Brian Tracy

English: All the adversity I've had in my life, all my troubles and obstacles, have strengthened me.
Chinese: 我生命中经历的所有逆境，所有的困难和障碍，都让我变得更强大。
Author: Walt Disney

English: Dreams are like stars. You may never touch them, but if you follow them, they will lead you to your destiny.
Chinese: 梦想就像星星。也许你永远无法触碰，但如果你跟随它们，它们将引领你找到人生的路。
Author: Liam Payne

English: The hardships that I encountered in the past will help me succeed in the future.
Chinese: 我过去遇到的困难将帮助我在未来取得成功。
Author: Philip Emeagwali

English: The constant happiness is curiosity.
Chinese: 求知欲是长久的快乐。
Author: Alice Munro

English: True friends are never apart, maybe in distance but never in heart.
Chinese: 真正的朋友从不分离，也许相距甚远，但心永远相连。
Author: Helen Keller

English: Nothing is so strong as gentleness, nothing so gentle as real strength.
Chinese: 没有什么比温柔更有力量，也没有什么比真正的力量更温柔。
Author: Saint Francis de Sales

English: Even a happy life cannot be without a measure of darkness, and the word happy would lose its meaning if it were not balanced by sadness.
Chinese: 即使是幸福的生活也不可能没有一丝黑暗，如果没有悲伤来平衡，快乐这个词就会失去意义。
Author: Carl Jung

English: Life is partly what we make it, and partly what it is made by the friends we choose.
Chinese: 生活一部分是我们自己创造的，另一部分是由我们选择的朋友造就的。
Author: Tennessee Williams

English: Without the dark there isn't light. Without the pain there is no relief.
Chinese: 没有黑暗，也就没有光明。没有痛苦，也就没有痛苦的缓解。
Author: Jenny Lawson

English: Respect for ourselves guides our morals, respect for others guides our manners.
Chinese: 对自己的尊重引导着我们的品德，对他人的尊重指导着我们的礼仪。
Author: Laurence Sterne

English: One can never consent to creep when one feels an impulse to soar.
Chinese: 一个人内心有了飞翔的冲动，就不会满足于在地上匍匐。
Author: Helen Keller

English: Do not look for happiness outside yourself. The awakened seek happiness inside.
Chinese: 不要向外寻找快乐，开悟之人在内心寻找幸福。
Author: Peter Deunov

English: Knowledge will give you power, but character respect.
Chinese: 知识会带给你力量，而品格会带给你他人的尊重。
Author: Bruce Lee

English: First keep peace with yourself, then you can also bring peace to others.
Chinese: 首先让自己保持平和，然后你也可以给别人带来平和。
Author: Thomas à Kempis

English: A multitude of small delights constitute happiness.
Chinese: 幸福就是许多小确幸的总和。
Author: Charles Baudelaire

English: Hope sees the invisible, feels the intangible, and achieves the impossible.
Chinese: 拥有希望可以看见他人不可见的，感受他人不能觉知的，并且实现那些不可能的事。
Author: Helen Keller

English: The only thing I knew how to do was to keep on keeping on like a bird that flew.
Chinese: 我唯一会的事情就是像只飞鸟一样继续前进。
Author: Bob Dylan

English: There is more treasure in books than in all the pirate's loot on Treasure Island.
Chinese: 书中的宝藏比海盗在金银岛上的所有战利品还要多。
Author: Walt Disney

English: Gratitude makes sense of our past, brings peace for today, and creates a vision for tomorrow.
Chinese: 感恩之心赋予过去意义，为当下带来平静，为未来创造愿景。
Author: Melody Beattie

English: One of the most sincere forms of respect is actually listening to what another has to say.
Chinese: 表达尊重最真诚的方式之一就是真正倾听别人说的话。
Author: Bryant H. McGill

English: If you have good thoughts they will shine out of your face like sunbeams and you will always look lovely.
Chinese: 你若思想美好，面容就会如阳光般灿烂，看上去永远可爱迷人。
Author: Roald Dahl

English: True love comes quietly, without banners or flashing lights.
Chinese: 真爱都是悄然降临，既不旗幡招展，也不灯火辉煌。
Author: Erich Segal

English: A great obstacle to happiness is to expect too much happiness.
Chinese: 获得幸福的一大障碍是对幸福期望太高。
Author: Bernard de Fontenelle

English: The verse of Qu Ping shines as bright as sun and moon, while palaces of Chu vanish like dreams at noon.
Chinese: 屈平辞赋悬日月，楚王台榭空山丘。
Author: 《江上吟》（许渊冲 译）

English: The two things in life you are in total control over are your attitude and your effort.
Chinese: 生活中你可以全权掌控的两件事：你的态度和你付出的努力。
Author: Billy Cox

English: True happiness is not attained through self-gratification, but through fidelity to a worthy purpose.
Chinese: 真正的幸福不是通过自我满足获得的，而是来自于对有价值目标的忠诚。
Author: Helen Keller

English: Love is just a word until someone comes along and gives it meaning.
Chinese: 爱不过是一个词而已，直到有一个人来到你面前，赋予它意义。
Author: Paulo Coelho

English: Green was the silence, wet was the light, the month of June trembled like a butterfly.
Chinese: 寂静生碧色，黎明露华浓，六月似蝴蝶在颤动。
Author: Pablo Neruda

English: Storms make trees take deeper roots.
Chinese: 暴风雨使得树木的根扎得更深。
Author: Dolly Parton

English: Passion makes the world go round. Love just makes it a safer place.
Chinese: 热情使世界转动。爱让它成为一个更安全的地方。
Author: Ice-T

English: It is very simple to be happy, but it is very difficult to be simple.
Chinese: 快乐很简单，但要做到简单却很困难。
Author: Tagore

English: If you spend your whole life waiting for the storm, you'll never enjoy the sunshine.
Chinese: 如果你一生都在等待暴风雨，你就永远不会享受阳光。
Author: Morris West

English: It is one thing to be clever and another to be wise.
Chinese: 聪明和智慧是两码事。
Author: George R.R. Martin

English: We are never really happy until we try to brighten the lives of others.
Chinese: 除非我们努力照亮别人的生活，否则我们永远不会真正快乐。
Author: Helen Keller

English: Wherever there is a human being, there is an opportunity for a kindness.
Chinese: 哪里有人，哪里就有良善的机会。
Author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

English: This universe is not outside of you. Look inside yourself; everything that you want, you already are.
Chinese: 宇宙并不在你之外。看看自己的内心吧。你想要的一切，都已尽在你身。
Author: Rumi

English: This universe is not outside of you. Look inside yourself; everything that you want, you already are.
Chinese: 宇宙并不在你之外。看看自己的内心吧。你想要的一切，都已尽在你身。
Author: Rumi

English: This universe is not outside of you. Look inside yourself; everything that you want, you already are.
Chinese: 宇宙并不在你之外。看看自己的内心吧。你想要的一切，都已尽在你身。
Author: Rumi

English: Neutral men are the devil's allies.
Chinese: 中立的人是魔鬼的盟友。
Author: Edwin Hubbel Chapin

English: Culture makes all men gentle.
Chinese: 文化使人温文尔雅。
Author: Menander

English: Good judgment comes from experience, and a lot of that comes from bad judgment.
Chinese: 正确的决断源自经验，而大部分经验源自错误的决断。
Author: Will Rogers

English: One benefit of Summer was that each day we had more light to read by.
Chinese: 夏天的好处之一便是我们有更多的阳光来阅读。
Author: Jeannette Walls

English: Don't go through life, grow through life.
Chinese: 不要此生匆匆过，但求每日都成长。
Author: Eric Butterworth

English: The quality, not the longevity, of one's life is what is important.
Chinese: 人重要的并非生命的长度，而是生命的质量。
Author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

English: Music is well said to be the speech of angels.
Chinese: 音乐被赞为天使的语言。
Author: Thomas Carlyle

English: Weaknesses are just strengths in the wrong environment.
Chinese: 弱点不过是优点处在了错误的环境中。
Author: Marianne Cantwell

English: If you try to be anyone but yourself, you will fail; if you are not true to your own heart, you will fail.
Chinese: 如果你试图成为别人而不是你自己，你将会失败；如果你不忠于自己的内心，你也会失败。
Author: Bob Dylan

English: How you love yourself is how you teach others to love you.
Chinese: 你爱自己的方式教会了别人如何爱你。
Author: Rupi Kaur

English: That it will never come again is what makes life sweet.
Chinese: 生活不会重来，这正是它美好的原因。
Author: Emily Dickinson

English: Maybe that's what life is: a wink of the eye and winking stars.
Chinese: 或许这就是人生：转瞬即逝，像闪烁的繁星。
Author: Jack Kerouac

English: Nature never did betray a heart that loved her.
Chinese: 大自然从不离弃一颗爱她的心。
Author: William Wordsworth

English: The only thing that matters is the everlasting present.
Chinese: 唯一重要的事情就是永恒的现在。
Author: Somerset Maugham

English: With the new day comes new strength and new thoughts.
Chinese: 全新的一天带给你全新的力量和思想。
Author: Eleanor Roosevelt

English: Attention is vitality. It connects you with others. It makes you eager. Stay eager.
Chinese: 专注带来活力。它让你和他人联结起来。它让你求知若渴、步履不停。
Author: Susan Sontag

English: To free us from the expectations of others, to give us back to ourselves—there lies the great, singular power of self-respect.
Chinese: 将自己从他人的期待中解放出来，把自己还给自己——这样你就获得了最为伟大、独特的自尊。
Author: Joan Didion

English: My big fish must be somewhere.
Chinese: 一定有属于我的大鱼在什么地方等着。
Author: Ernest Hemingway

English: There are no seven wonders of the world in the eyes of a child. There are seven million.
Chinese: 在孩子们眼中，这世上不是只有七大奇迹，而是有七百万种奇迹。
Author: Walt Streightiff

English: The real difficulty is to overcome how you think about yourself.
Chinese: 真正的困难是克服你对自己的看法。
Author: Maya Angelou

English: The only limit to the height of your achievements is the reach of your dreams and your willingness to work hard for them.
Chinese: 唯一限制你成就高度的，是你梦想的限度，以及为之努力的意愿。
Author: Michelle Obama

English: A loving heart is the beginning of all knowledge.
Chinese: 一颗充满热爱的心是一切知识的起源。
Author: Thomas Carlyle

English: You think you know someone. But mostly you just know what you want to know.
Chinese: 你以为你很了解某个人，但大多时候你了解的只是你想了解的部分。
Author: Joe Hill

English: We laughed and kept saying "see you soon", but inside we both knew we'd never see each other again.
Chinese: 我们笑着说再见，但我们都心知肚明，再见遥遥无期。
Author: 《海上钢琴师》

English: Adopting the right attitude can convert a negative stress into a positive one.
Chinese: 采取正确的态度可以将负面的压力转化为积极的动力。
Author: Hans Selye

English: Kind words can be short and easy to speak, but their echoes are truly endless.
Chinese: 善良的话语或许很简短，很简单，但产生的回响却是无穷止尽。
Author: Mother Teresa

English: What lies behind you and what lies in front of you, pales in comparison to what lies inside of you.
Chinese: 无论是你的过去，还是将来，与你的内在相比，都微不足道。
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

English: Success is the sum of small efforts — repeated day in and day out.
Chinese: 成功就是日复一日那一点点小小努力的积累。
Author: Robert Collier

English: Climb mountains not so the world can see you, but so you can see the world.
Chinese: 爬上山顶并不是为了让世界看到你，而是为了让你看到整个世界。
Author: David McCullough Jr.

English: Don't go through life; grow through life.
Chinese: 别只是过活，要通过生活获得成长。
Author: Eric Butterworth

English: Appreciation is a wonderful thing. It makes what is excellent in others belong to us as well.
Chinese: 欣赏是一件美妙的事，它让别人的优点也成为我们自己的。
Author: 伏尔泰

English: Here's to a vacation of no regrets!
Chinese: 为无悔的假期干杯！
Author: Joan Rylen

English: Magic is believing in yourself; if you can do that, you can make anything happen.
Chinese: 相信自己是种魔法，能做到这一点，就可以实现任何事。
Author: 歌德

English: Happiness is not by chance, but by choice.
Chinese: 幸福靠的不是运气，而是选择。
Author: Jim Rohn

English: If life throws you a few bad notes or vibrations, don't let them interrupt or alter your song.
Chinese: 即便生活给了你一些不和谐的音符，也别让它们破坏你的人生之歌。
Author: Suzy Kassem

English: The most wasted of all days is one without laughter.
Chinese: 没有欢笑的一天便最是虚度。
Author: E. E. Cummings

English: One man with courage makes a majority.
Chinese: 若有勇气，一个人抵得上千军万马。
Author: Andrew Jackson

English: Life is a pure flame, and we live by an invisible sun within us.
Chinese: 生命是一束纯净的火焰，我们依靠内心看不见的太阳而存在。
Author: Sir Thomas Browne

English: Life is a beautiful magnificent thing, even to a jellyfish.
Chinese: 生命美好而壮丽，就算对一只水母来说也是。
Author: Charlie Chaplin

English: The cure to boredom is curiosity. There is no cure for curiosity.
Chinese: 无聊的解药是好奇心，但好奇心没有解药。
Author: Dorothy Parker

English: The bravest sight in the world is to see a great man struggling against adversity.
Chinese: 世界上最勇敢的景象，便是勇者无畏地与逆境搏斗。
Author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

English: You must take life the way it comes at you and make the best of it.
Chinese: 要接受生活本来的样子，而后尽力而为。
Author: Yann Martel

English: Never, never, never give up.
Chinese: 不，绝不，永不放弃。
Author: Winston Churchill

English: We must act out passion before we can feel it.
Chinese: 要感受热情，须先表达热情。
Author: 让-保罗·萨特

English: Love one another, but make not a bond of love: let it rather be a moving sea between the shores of your souls.
Chinese: 相爱吧！但别让爱成为羁绊，爱应当是两个灵魂间涌动的海洋。
Author: Kahlil Gibran

English: The horizon of life is broadened chiefly by means of the enlargement of heart.
Chinese: 扩展生活的视野，主要靠开阔心胸。
Author: Hugh Black

English: Nothing behind me, everything ahead of me, as is ever so on the road.
Chinese: 抛开顾虑，探索未知，永远在路上。
Author: Jack Kerouac

English: To exist is to change, to change is to mature, to mature is to go on creating oneself endlessly.
Chinese: 生存就意味着去改变，改变就意味着成熟，而成熟就意味着孜孜不倦地创造自我。
Author: Henri Bergson

English: If you wish to reach the highest, begin at the lowest.
Chinese: 若想到达最高处，先从最低处做起。
Author: Publilius Syrus

English: Love and a cough cannot be hid.
Chinese: 爱与咳嗽均无法掩藏。
Author: George Herbert

English: Tomorrow belongs to those who can hear it coming.
Chinese: 明天属于那些能听见它来临的人。
Author: David Bowie

English: Changes and progress very rarely are gifts from above. They come out of struggles from below.
Chinese: 鲜有改变和进步是上天赐予的，它们来自于自己的苦心奋斗。
Author: 诺姆·乔姆斯基

English: Never give up. Expect only the best from life and take action to get it.
Chinese: 永远不要言弃。要永远只期待最好的事物，并为之付出行动。
Author: Catherine Pulsifer

English: A book should serve as the ax for the frozen sea within us.
Chinese: 书籍是一把利斧，凿开我们内心冰封的海洋。
Author: Franz Kafka

English: Learn from yesterday, live for today, hope for tomorrow.
Chinese: 借鉴昨天，活在今天，憧憬明天。
Author: Albert Einstein

English: Beauty is how you feel inside, and it reflects in your eyes.
Chinese: 美是一种内心的感觉，并反映在你的眼睛里。
Author: Sophia Loren

English: Love is the master key that opens the gates of happiness.
Chinese: 爱是打开幸福之门的万能钥匙。
Author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.

English: The world spins. We stumble on. It is enough.
Chinese: 世界快速旋转，我们踉跄前行，就已足够。
Author: Colum McCann

English: Reprove thy friend privately; commend him publicly.
Chinese: 在私下批评你的朋友，在公开场合赞扬他。
Author: Solon

English: The weak can never forgive. Forgiveness is the attribute of the strong.
Chinese: 弱者永远不懂宽恕，宽恕是强者的品质。
Author: 甘地

English: Action is the foundational key to all success.
Chinese: 行动是所有成功的根本。
Author: Pablo Picasso

English: The art of being happy lies in the power of extracting happiness from common things.
Chinese: 幸福的诀窍在于能从平凡事物中提取快乐。
Author: Henry Ward Beecher

English: Children are not things to be molded, but are people to be unfolded.
Chinese: 孩子不是有待铸造的物料，而是有待启发的人。
Author: Jess Lair
